spellbook.finance/limitations: A row is a catalogue price change between two snapshots, never a sale, a quote, or what a marketplace will pay today. Confirm any number on the marketplace before acting on it.
The list is already ordered by size of change and is the whole list the window produced. It ranks nothing by opportunity, and it is not a buy list. Decide what matters yourself.
A printing absent from both lists either moved too little to make this window or had no second snapshot inside it. Absence never means the price held.
sealedGainers and sealedLosers are populated only on the 30d and 90d windows. Without Investor access the backend returns the top three of each and gatedCount says how many rows it withheld.
A Pokémon row is qualified by productId, language, finish and variant. Do not collapse Reverse Holo, 1st Edition or other variants into regular or foil.
availability.status unavailable and missingFields name absent evidence. Never turn an unavailable result into a zero change or an empty-market claim.

A row's swing30d reads the price history of that row's finish. It is null under $1 and below 10 measured moves, and it is absent on the 30d and 90d windows and on boards published before the field existed. A missing swing30d says nothing about how far the price moves.
A game can be omitted when its feature is disabled for the caller.

generatedAt stamps the publication generation behind a cached daily or weekly board; date and computedAt stamp a stored run when present. Check limitations for a stale generation before describing the board as current.

description: Read which card printings changed price the most over one window: daily, weekly, 30d or 90d. Returns gainers and losers with exact game, catalog product, language, finish and marketplace variant when the source provides them, plus current and previous prices, dollar and percent change, swing30d (the typical 30 day move in percent: the median absolute 30 day change over the last 90 daily closes), a canonical SpellBook Finance cardUrl, and run timestamps. Call this to answer "what is moving this week" instead of guessing, then call spellbook_card_prices for one printing's per-source prices. An unavailable result names why no supported rows can be returned.

game.description: Restrict card movers to one game. Omit for the default Magic board.

window.description: Which price-change window to read: daily, weekly, 30d or 90d. Omit for the default window.

name: spellbook_movers
